en.headline: Observatory records 36.9°C, new all-time high since 1884
en.dek: Under Severe Typhoon Dolphin’s outer subsiding air, the Hong Kong Observatory headquarters reached 36.9 degrees Celsius by mid-afternoon, while Sheung Shui hit 39.7–39.8 degrees, the highest at any automatic station since the 1980s.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said its headquarters recorded a maximum temperature of 36.9 degrees Celsius on Sunday afternoon, surpassing the earlier reading of 36.8 degrees and setting a new all-time high since records began in 1884.

Sheung Shui registered 39.7 to 39.8 degrees, described as the highest temperature recorded at any automatic weather station in Hong Kong since those stations were installed in the 1980s. Happy Valley earlier reached 38 degrees, with multiple New Territories and urban stations above 37 degrees.

The Observatory attributed the extreme heat to the outer subsiding airflow of Severe Typhoon Dolphin, which is moving across Zhejiang and inland. Extremely hot conditions are expected to continue through Tuesday, with some areas again reaching 37 degrees or above.

zh.headline: 天文台錄36.9度再破有紀錄最高溫 上水見39.8度
zh.dek: 受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，天文台總部周日下午錄得36.9度，刷新1884年有紀錄以來最高氣溫，上水自動氣象站更高見39.7至39.8度。
body: 香港天文台表示，總部周日下午錄得最高氣溫36.9度，較早前的36.8度再升，刷新1884年有紀錄以來的最高氣溫。
上水自動氣象站錄得39.7至39.8度，為1980年代設置自動氣象站以來本港境內最高紀錄。跑馬地早前見38度，新界及市區多站超過37度。
天文台指高溫由強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流造成，預料極端酷熱天氣持續至周二，部分地區氣溫可達37度或以上。
